members.name: ensemble_signal_v1
members.thesis: No single strategy works in all market conditions. By running 4 distinct sub-strategies simultaneously — VWAP mean-reversion, EMA crossover trend, Bollinger breakout, and RSI reversal — and entering only when >= 3 of 4 agree on direction, we create a robust ensemble signal. Each sub-strategy capture
entry_long: close > VWAP OR Ensemble_Score == 4 (override VWAP filter if full consensus)
filters: India VIX < 25; halve size if VIX > 20
No entries before 09:30 (indicator warm-up) or after 15:10
NIFTY 50 not down > 1.5% from previous close
weaknesses: Sub-strategies are correlated — VWAP reversion and RSI reversal often agree, while EMA crossover and BB breakout often agree; effective diversification is less than 4 independent signals
The ensemble can produce conflicting signals between mean-reversion (Sub1, Sub4) and trend-following (Sub2, Sub3), creating a structural tension; 3/4 consensus rarely occurs
Target/stop ratio of 40/20 = 2.0 with 61% win rate seems optimistic; slippage and the tight 20 bps stop will cause many premature stop-outs in volatile 1-min bars
members.prior_art: Ensemble methods in ML (Random Forest voting); Elder's Triple Screen; combining mean-reversion and momentum signals discussed in Chan (2013) 'Algorithmic Trading'

members.name: adversarial_ensemble_v1
members.thesis: This meta-strategy runs 5 sub-strategies simultaneously (VWAP mean reversion, ORB breakout, RSI divergence, volume spike, and EMA pullback) and only enters when at least 3 of 5 agree on direction AND none of the other 2 actively contradict. The adversarial validation means each sub-strategy tries to
filters: no trades first 15 min or last 15 min
embedded in ema_signal and orb_signal sub-strategies
weaknesses: Extremely low frequency — 5 strategies agreeing with no contradiction is very rare (maybe 2-3 times per week)
Implementation complexity is high — 5 concurrent strategy engines with real-time scoring
The sub-strategies can be correlated (e.g., VWAP mean reversion and RSI divergence often fire together), reducing true diversification of signals
members.prior_art: Ensemble methods — common in ML but rare in rule-based trading. Adversarial validation is inspired by GAN architecture concepts applied to signal filtering.
